workflow: Production cad-core locks a viewport, rejects zoom, pan and direct scale/center/twist view application without mutation, commits a model LINE, unlocks and changes/pans the camera, relocks and performs undo/redo, serializes KDRAW1, then a separate reader validates magic, envelope, payload length, manifest SHA-256 and document SHA-256 before parsing document.json without deserializeKDraw.
result: All three refused operations returned VIEWPORT_LOCKED at revision 1 with an exact unchanged camera; the locked viewport allowed the model LINE, unlock/navigation/relock produced one atomic operation each, undo/redo restored false/true, and the independent reader recovered revision 8 with two entities and the exact locked camera.
